name: The Commons on Meridian

careTiers.label: Level 1
careTiers.description: A hand with medication and one or two daily tasks.

careTiers.label: Level 2
careTiers.description: Daily help with dressing, bathing and getting about.

careTiers.label: Level 3
careTiers.description: Substantial help with most activities, several times a day.

careTiers.label: Level 4
careTiers.description: Two-person assistance and full support with daily living.

careTiers.label: All-inclusive
careTiers.description: Memory care is priced all-in — no separate care levels.

layouts.name: Assisted Living – Studio
layouts.description: A single room with a kitchenette, a walk-in shower and a window seat.

layouts.name: Assisted Living – 1 Bedroom
layouts.description: A separate bedroom with a door, a living room and a kitchenette.

layouts.name: Assisted Living – 2 Bedroom
layouts.description: Two bedrooms and two bathrooms — for couples, or a second room for family to stay.

layouts.name: Memory Care – Studio
layouts.description: A private room and bathroom off the memory care household.

layouts.name: Memory Care – Studio Deluxe
layouts.description: A larger private suite with a separate sitting area and its own bathroom.

layouts.name: Memory Care – 1 Bedroom
layouts.description: A bedroom with a door and a sitting room, inside the secured household.

layouts.name: Memory Care – Companion Suite
layouts.description: A shared suite: two private sleeping areas and one bathroom. Each half is listed on its own.

buildings.name: The Commons on Meridian
buildings.blurb: One building, two wings: a secured memory care household around its own courtyard, and assisted living along 86th Street, joined by the dining rooms, bistro and salon.

legalNote: Rates shown are a starting point and change with availability. The care charge is set by a nurse assessment before move-in.
